scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name .next -o -name .turbo -o -name dist -o -name .expo \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -type f \( -name tsconfig.tsbuildinfo \) -delete
scripts.hard:clean: find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name .next -o -name .turbo -o -name dist -o -name .expo \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -type f \( -name pnpm-lock.yaml -o -name tsconfig.tsbuildinfo \) -delete
